reopened_reason: RS-063 through RS-065 replace impossible axis-aligned oddness cubes with a realizable matched-dependency quotient and establish scalar factorization through the OOO residue image.

new_assertions.body: The reachable fixed-presence oddness carrier is not a free Boolean cube: no complete three-coordinate E/O cube occurs on the three hard carriers, and almost every observed presence fiber has linear constraints beyond width parity.

For frozen degree<=2 matrix D2 and OOO matrix C, the invariant cubic correction dimension is the rank of the structural map phi: ker(D2^T)->OOO, lambda |-> lambda^T C; equivalently rank([D2 C])-rank(D2). Individual pivot triples are gauges.

Because the scalar target y is exactly representable by degree<=2 plus OOO on the tested hard carriers, its matched-dependency residue factors through phi: if lambda^T C=0 for lambda in ker(D2^T), then lambda^T y=0.

The scalar dependency image dimensions 1,2,2 are the invariant target dimensions relative to degree<=2 expressed on realizable structural dependencies, while the OOO structural quotient dimensions 75,294,16 measure available cubic structure rather than value complexity.

On 4x5-k4, dim ker(phi)=371-294=77. This is the dimension of the degree<=2 dependency subspace not resolved by OOO features; its scalar image is zero under the OOO-exact decoder. The equality to the prior 77 presence-containing cubic rank directions is dimensional, not a canonical basis identification.

The next compact decoder object should be a mechanically defined structural functional on the OOO dependency-residue quotient, or an equivalent DTS/circuit law, rather than fitted coefficients on raw OOO monomials.
